title: Power Apps: GitHub models and wider availability for the generative page agent in Maker Studio
summary: The roadmap details and the two documented tenant-control paths are supported. However, the blanket statement that GitHub organisation policies are outside Microsoft's documentation is incorrect: Microsoft documents organisation-level access restrictions for Power Apps source-control integration. Remove that statement or narrow it to the undocumented applicability of those policies to this generative-page connection.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: property name and portal-only treatment
claims.claim: No setting-specific API, CLI call or PowerShell property is documented for the canvas authoring-agent GitHub tenant control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agentic coauthoring" "GitHub" API PowerShell tenant; opened canvas-authoring-agent, tenant-settings, Set-TenantSettings, pac admin and list-tenantsettings. No GitHub authoring-agent property or equivalent call is documented.

claims.claim: The GitHub tenant setting controls maker GitHub connections for the canvas studio authoring agent in preview.
claims.quote: Agentic coauthoring in Power Apps using GitHub (preview) | Controls whether makers can connect their GitHub accounts to use the authoring agent in Power Apps canvas studio.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that the canvas authoring-agent GitHub toggle governs generative pages.
claims.quote: Searched: generative pages GitHub models credits billing data processing tenant setting disable; "generative pages" "disable" "GitHub". Opened generative-pages, canvas-authoring-agent and tenant-settings; the documented toggle covers canvas studio, not generative pages.

claims.claim: The Copilot preview tenant control is under Power Platform admin center > Settings > Tenant settings > Copilot in Power Apps (preview).
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select Settings to open the Tenant settings page.
3. Select Copilot in Power Apps (preview), and then set the toggle to Off.
claims.fix: Keep the cited path, but add: 'The tenant-settings reference gives a different route to the same page: Manage > Tenant settings (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/tenant-settings).'

claims.claim: No documented automation equivalent was found for the broad Copilot preview maker tenant toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot in Power Apps" "preview" "Set-TenantSettings"; "Copilot" "tenant" "powerPlatform" "disable" settings API. Opened ai-overview, list-tenantsettings, Set-TenantSettings and pac admin; disableCopilot documents how-to answers, not this broad toggle.

claims.claim: Copilot in Power Apps (preview) is a tenant-level control for makers' Copilot preview features.
claims.quote: The following settings are configured at the tenant level. ... Copilot in Power Apps (preview) | Enables Copilot preview features for users who make apps.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that the Copilot preview toggle applies to this General Availability generative-page GitHub integration.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps tenant settings Copilot preview GitHub agentic coauthoring PowerShell Power Platform API property; "generative pages" "disable" "GitHub". Opened ai-overview, tenant-settings and generative-pages; none confirms this applicability.

claims.claim: No tenant UI or automation switch specific to generative pages or their GitHub-hosted models is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "disable" "GitHub"; generative pages GitHub models credits billing data processing tenant setting disable. Opened generative-pages, tenant-settings, list-tenantsettings, Set-TenantSettings and pac admin; no integration-specific switch found.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented the processing locations and boundaries of this generative-page GitHub connection.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" GitHub data residency processing prompts. Opened generative-pages and canvas-authoring-agent; the latter describes a different canvas feature and supplies no generative-page GitHub processing location.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented which inputs the generative-page GitHub connection sends to GitHub.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" GitHub data residency processing prompts. Opened generative-pages and canvas-authoring-agent; the canvas notice about prompts and application context does not identify inputs for the generative-page integration.

claims.claim: Detailed billing arrangements for the generative-page GitHub model connection are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "GitHub" "credits"; "generative pages" licensing billing meter Power Apps. Opened generative-pages, canvas-authoring-agent and pay-as-you-go-meters; none specifies detailed billing for this planned connection.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a Power Platform meter for this GitHub model-access path.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" licensing billing meter Power Apps. Opened generative-pages and pay-as-you-go-meters; the meter list and its scope do not name generative-page GitHub model requests.

claims.claim: Generally available Copilot features in Power Apps can only be turned off through Microsoft Support.
claims.quote: Generally available Copilot features are on by default and can't be turned off except by Microsoft Support. To turn them off, a tenant admin needs to contact Support.

claims.claim: GitHub organisation policies on the developer side are outside Microsoft's documentation.
claims.quote: If your GitHub organization has non-Microsoft application access restrictions enabled, an organization administrator must approve the OAuth app used by the Power Apps GitHub connector.
claims.fix: Remove 'GitHub organisation policies on the developer side are outside Microsoft's documentation.' Microsoft documents GitHub organisation access restrictions for a different Power Apps integration; this does not establish that those restrictions govern generative-page model access.
